scenarios.task: Erect and inspect tube-and-clamp scaffolding against the brick tower of St Leonard's Church for repointing work on the upper facade.
hazards: Falling tools onto busy Shoreditch High Street pavement
Historic brickwork collapse under anchor loads
steps: Verify permit to work and heritage consent conditions with the foreman
Check ground bearing on the churchyard paths and position base plates
Build scaffold bays with guardrails, toe boards and brick guards
Tie into structure only at approved anchor points per heritage survey
Tag the scaffold with Scafftag after competent-person inspection
Brief exclusion zone for pedestrians below before work begins

rubric.pass_if: Harness tied off 100% of time above 2 metres
Exclusion zone and debris netting in place before first tool is raised
No unapproved drilling or ties into historic fabric
Scaffold tagged and recorded before use

scenarios.robot_role: Carries scaffold boards and clamps up the tower stair and performs laser scan of facade condition before crews ascend.

scenarios.task: Repair failed lead flashing at the chancel roof gutter of St Leonard's Church without damaging adjoining slate and timbers.
hazards: Hot work fire risk near 200-year-old timber
steps: Set up roof ladder hooks and crawling boards over fragile slates
Remove failed flashing with non-vibratory tools
Hot work permit issued; fire watch and extinguisher staged at gutter level
Form and weld replacement lead flashing to match existing detailing
Wet down work area and complete 60-minute fire watch after hot work ends
Log material and lead waste for controlled disposal

rubric.pass_if: Crawling boards used; no direct foot traffic on slates
Permit, extinguisher, and fire watch all present and documented
Respirator worn, no eating/drinking on roof, hygiene break observed
New flashing detail matches original patina and joints

scenarios.task: Test and re-bond the lightning protection system on St Leonard's Church tower, running new earth rods in the churchyard.
hazards: Live electrical testing near buried services
Excavation strikes on unmarked graves and utilities
Working at height on tower ladder
steps: Complete CAT-and-genny scan of churchyard before any digging
Isolate and lock out any connected circuits; apply personal locks
Climb tower using twin-lanyard technique to inspect air terminal
Continuity-test down conductors and record readings against BS EN 62305
Drive new earth rods and bond with exothermic weld
Complete test certificate and hand to steward for human sign-off

rubric.pass_if: Personal lock applied and verified before testing
Utility scan completed and dig zone marked before breaking ground
Earth resistance readings within spec and documented
No conductor clipped to historic stonework without consented fixings

scenarios.robot_role: Carries test gear up the tower stairs and streams camera inspection of the air terminal to the ground crew.

scenarios.task: Survey and safely remove suspected asbestos lagging on pipework in the Victorian boiler room under St Leonard's Church.
steps: Review refurbishment survey and confirm enclosure plan with licensed supervisor
Build negative-pressure enclosure with airlocks and warning signage
Damp down lagging before removal; no dry cutting
Double-bag waste, clear-label, and log for licensed disposal
Four-stage clearance including air monitoring before enclosure teardown
Decontaminate personnel through shower sequence each exit

rubric.pass_if: Negative pressure verified and logged before removal starts
All material kept wet; no power tools used dry
Every bag labelled, manifested and consignment note complete
Analyst clearance certificate obtained before re-entry

scenarios.robot_role: Tows bagged waste through the airlock corridor and carries fibre counters into the enclosure to reduce worker entries.

scenarios.task: Rig and lift replacement oak bell-frame timbers into the tower of St Leonard's Church using a mobile crane positioned in the closed churchyard lane.
hazards: Crush points in tight tower shaft
Overhead power lines on Shoreditch High Street
Load swing in urban wind channel
steps: Attend lift plan briefing; confirm crane pad bearing on churchyard ground
Verify exclusion zones and road closure permits with foreman
Inspect slings and shackles; calculate load weights and sling angles
Direct crane via hand signals and radio; tag lines on load at all times
Land timbers onto frame shoes without contacting tower walls
Complete post-lift gear inspection and rigging log

rubric.pass_if: Can state load weight, radius and SWL margin before lift
No personnel under suspended load at any time
Single designated signaller; radio check completed
All gear inspected and tagged before and after use

scenarios.robot_role: Flies a pre-lift camera pass into the belfry to confirm landing clearances and check for loose masonry.

scenarios.task: Excavate a drainage trench along the north churchyard path of St Leonard's Church to stop water pooling against the tower foundation.
hazards: Buried human remains and old vaults
steps: Attend heritage toolbox talk on remains protocol and stop-work triggers
Hand-dig test pits before any machine entry; watch for memorial stones
Shore or batter trench sides beyond 1.2 metres depth
Install perforated pipe and gravel filter per drawing
Backfill in layers and compact without disturbing adjacent memorials
Report any bone or vault find immediately and stop work

rubric.pass_if: Stops work and reports immediately on any suspected find
No entry to unshored trench over 1.2 metres
Hand-dig only within 500 mm of marked services
Falls and outfall match drawing; water flows clear in test

scenarios.robot_role: Carries tools and water bottles along the trench line and uses ground-penetrating radar sled to pre-mark anomalies.

scenarios.task: Remove, edge-protect and reinstall a Victorian stained-glass lancet window at St Leonard's Church for lead-light conservation.
scenarios.hazards: Sharp glass and lead came handling
steps: Photograph and number every panel before removal
Apply facing glass and edge tape to each panel
Cut old fixing ties carefully; support panel from outside
Crane-adjacent hand-off each panel to padded stillage
Reinstall with new conservation ties and isothermal glazing backing
Clean site and verify no lead dust residue remains on interior sills

rubric.pass_if: Panels numbered and photographed before first removal
Gloves and mask worn; wash-up before breaks
Zero breakages or new cracks recorded
Ties and backing installed to conservation spec

scenarios.robot_role: Holds and rotates padded stillages so the apprentice can edge-tape heavy panels without overreaching.

credential.name: Heritage Church Site Readiness Card — St Leonard's Shoreditch
